title: London drought and Mishlove's first meeting with Owens
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of London drought and Mishlove's first meeting with Owens, about summer 1976 at London, University of London, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: reached out to Owens to end that drought and ended up inviting him to a conference sponsored by the Paris Science Foundation, the University of London in the summer of 76. So I met him there and befriended him

plain: A researcher of psychic claims named Jeffrey Mishlove says that during a drought in London in the summer of 1976, someone contacted Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic powers, to end it. Mishlove says Owens was then invited to a conference at the University of London, where Mishlove met him and became his friend, and he names the researchers Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ in the same account. If true, it would be an example of a man said to influence the weather with his mind.
